prompt: A static camera at kerb height on a rain-soaked night street, a cast-iron lamp post close beside the lens taking up the left edge of the frame, its gaslight a cold green. Coming straight at us down the near lane, slightly right of centre, one open 1920s roadster with two round headlamps blazing, one driver behind the screen, a rooster tail of spray lit orange by a distant warehouse fire behind it. Wet cobbles, shuttered brick buildings, an otherwise empty street. Nothing carries lettering. Thanks.
